-- Final verification
WITH session_base AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    event_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'ga_session_id' THEN CAST(ep.value.int_value AS STRING) END) as ga_session_id,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'medium' THEN ep.value.string_value END),
      traffic_source.medium
    ) as medium,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'source' THEN ep.value.string_value END),
      traffic_source.source
    ) as source
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_202012*` e
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(e.event_params) AS ep
  WHERE e.event_name = 'page_view'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, event_date, traffic_source.medium, traffic_source.source
),
sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id, event_date, ga_session_id, medium, source
  FROM session_base
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    medium,
    source,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('google', 'bing', 'yahoo', 'baidu', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'yandex')
           AND (LOWER(medium) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('google', 'bing', 'yahoo', 'baidu', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'yandex')
           OR medium = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) LIKE '%facebook%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%fb%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%instagram%' 
            OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%linkedin%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%pinterest%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%tiktok%' 
            OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%twitter%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%badoo%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%whatsapp%')
           AND (LOWER(medium) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('youtube', 'vimeo', 'dailymotion', 'netflix', 'disneyplus', 'twitch')
            OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%youtube%')
           AND (LOWER(medium) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') OR LOWER(medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN LOWER(source) = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) LIKE '%push' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%mobile%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%notification%' THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) LIKE '%alibaba%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%amazon%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%google shopping%' 
            OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%shopify%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%etsy%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%ebay%' 
            OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%stripe%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%walmart%')
           AND (LOWER(medium) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) LIKE '%alibaba%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%amazon%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%google shopping%' 
            OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%shopify%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%etsy%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%ebay%' 
            OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%stripe%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%walmart%') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) LIKE '%facebook%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%fb%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%instagram%' 
            OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%linkedin%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%pinterest%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%tiktok%' 
            OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%twitter%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%badoo%' OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%whatsapp%')
           OR LOWER(medium) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('youtube', 'vimeo', 'dailymotion', 'netflix', 'disneyplus', 'twitch')
            OR LOWER(source) LIKE '%youtube%')
           OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%video%' THEN 'Organic Video'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END as channel_group
  FROM sessions
)
SELECT channel_group, COUNT(*) as session_count
FROM classified
GROUP BY channel_group
ORDER BY session_count DESC
